segments.name: North America
segments.description: Sells YI-brand security cameras and other smart hardware through Amazon and other e-commerce platforms to customers in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: AMC Robotics Corporation has Amazon online accounts in the U.S., Canada, and Europe.

segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Sells YI-brand security cameras and other smart hardware through European Amazon and third-party online stores to customers in Europe.
segments.evidence: The Company operates online stores on e-commerce platforms with separate platform accounts serving North America and Europe.

segments.name: China
segments.description: Segment comprised the two China-based variable interest entities, which recorded no revenue during the year.
segments.evidence: Given that the two VIEs, Xiaoyun and Yishijue, are headquartered and operated in China, the consolidated financial statements are bifurcated into three segments: (1) North America, (2) Europe, and (3) China.

revenueModel.text: Customers buying cameras on e-commerce platforms pay for hardware, while related party Kami pays AMC a revenue share on cloud subscriptions sold to those camera buyers.
revenueModel.evidence: AMC recognizes its revenue share when Kami receives subscription payments from users acquired through AMC's camera sales.

changes.text: In December 2025 the company stopped using the Xiaoyun and Yishijue Amazon stores and moved sales to its own or third-party platforms.
changes.evidence: However, in December 2025, AMC determined that, based on limited transaction volume through these stores, it would transition its sales channel to its own or other third-party platforms and is no longer utilizing the stores from Xiaoyun and Yishijue.

changes.text: In January 2025 ownership of the North America Amazon store was transferred to AMC from Ants.
changes.evidence: Effective as of January 9, 2025, the ownership of Amazon store North America has been successfully transferred to AMC from Ants.

changes.text: In August 2024 the two China VIEs agreed to transfer their Amazon store ownership to AMC.
changes.evidence: In August 2024, AMC and the two VIEs entered into separate business transfer agreements.
